value.rationale: The precise question is the mechanism of exceptionally deep visits in a natural random interval system. The complete three-regime classification of the successful excursion first-step mark (tight depth, macroscopic uniform depth, two-sided geometric overshoot) explains the known stationary threshold dynamically, and the independent exponential time law separates the waiting clock from the successful mechanism. This is neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor merely a re-expression of known stationary masses.
